document.body:
subsidiary: ceat, cover_type: stock_policy, policy_ref: POL-RPG-CEAT-09, underwriter: New India Assurance / RPG Group Marine & Property Package, insured: True, covered_perils: Manufacturing Casing Defects, Warehouse Fire & Water Contamination, OEM Transit Road Hazard, claim_workflow_steps: 1. High-resolution sidewall and bead photographic capture, 2. Barcode & DOT serial number OCR verification, 3. Generate Snap & Score Cryptographically Hashed Inspection PDF Dossier, 4. Automatic dispatch to CEAT Warranty & Risk Portal via NeuralMesh webhook

subsidiary: harrisons, cover_type: stock_policy, policy_ref: POL-RPG-HARRISONS-09, underwriter: United India Insurance Marine Cargo & Stock Floater, insured: True, covered_perils: Storage Mould Bloom due to excessive ambient moisture, Transit Water Ingress, Spontaneous Heat Oxidation, claim_workflow_steps: 1. Measure mould surface coverage ratio via CV colorimetry, 2. Cross-reference warehouse hygrothermograph sensor log for RH > 65% trigger, 3. Compile Marine Underwriting Survey Dossier with SSIM loss verification, 4. Forward claim pack to HML Plant Risk Management Bureau

subsidiary: kec, cover_type: project_policy, policy_ref: POL-RPG-KEC-09, underwriter: ICICI Lombard EPC Erection All Risks (EAR) & Delay in Startup Policy, insured: True, covered_perils: Severe Atmospheric Galvanic Depletion, Wind Storm Member Buckling, Transport Joint Rupture, claim_workflow_steps: 1. Record GPS tower coordinates and phase identifier, 2. Document zinc coating loss percentage and structural chord deflection, 3. Issue P1/P2 field maintenance work order and bill-of-quantities replacement, 4. Transmit structural proof dossier to project insurer

subsidiary: raychem, cover_type: project_policy, policy_ref: POL-RPG-RAYCHEM-09, underwriter: Tata AIG Comprehensive Product Liability & Infrastructure Guarantee, insured: True, covered_perils: Dielectric Flashover, Thermal Runaway under rated voltage, Defective Polymer Shrink Recovery, claim_workflow_steps: 1. Record thermal imaging infrared gradient and partial discharge (HFPD) readings, 2. Quarantine defective joint splice assembly, 3. Export Snap & Score engineering dossier with visual carbon tree proof, 4. Dispatch remake kit claim to Raychem Quality & Warranty Bureau
